title: Testing, Debugging, and Documentation
learning_outcomes: Explain and apply core ideas from Testing, Debugging, and Documentation.
Trace one small example and identify a meaningful edge case.
Use official documentation to check details that depend on the toolchain or ecosystem.

overview_visual.alt_text: Roadmap for module 18, Testing, Debugging, and Documentation.

notes: Test, diagnose, document, and review Rust software with repeatable quality practices. Make tests deterministic and focused. Documentation examples should be executable where possible, and mocks should not obscure the behavior that matters.
